text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is reporting on the results of the traffic calming poll undertaken on Winnett Avenue, between Durham Avenue and Arlington Avenue. The poll did not provide a response rate greater than the 50 percent plus one ballot and the minimum 60 percent "in favour" required by the traffic calming policy in order to install speed humps on the subject section of Winnett Avenue was not achieved. Accordingly, continuing the process to install speed humps on Winnett Avenue, between Durham Avenue and Arlington Avenue, is not recommended.

The Toronto and East York Community Council directed: 1. The City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install four speed humps on Winnett Avenue, between Durham Avenue and Arlington Avenue, generally as shown on Drawing No. 421G-2783, dated November 2017 attached to the report (March 22, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District.
